descriptionHtml:
Turn heads at a club awards night with a Scottie Barnes face mask that's made for photos, laughs and a bit of mischief. Pair it with a costume, or keep it simple and let the sports star face do the talking.

Scottie Barnes Card Face Mask for Parties

We print this sports star mask in full colour on thick 350gsm silk card, cut it to the shape of the face and pre-cut the eye holes. Elastic and sticky tabs are included. Want a mask of someone who isn't in our range, like the birthday boy or the bride-to-be? We can make one from your photo.

Why you'll love it

  • Brilliant for photo booths and group shots
  • Thick 350gsm silk card holds its shape all night
  • Semi-waterproof finish, so it copes with spilt drinks and outdoor parties
  • Pre-cut eye holes, with elastic and sticky tabs included
  • Full-colour digital print for a sharp, recognisable face

Size & details

  • Material: 350gsm silk card, full-colour digital print
  • Finish: semi-waterproof
  • Fit: one size for adults; elastic and sticky tabs included
  • Pre-cut eye holes; cut to the shape of the face
  • Packaging: board-backed envelope

Delivery

Printed in our UK workshop and posted to you. Dispatch and postage options are shown at checkout.

Order one for a big-game watch party, or buy a few so the whole group can turn up as Scottie Barnes.

Please note

This is an unofficial novelty product made for fun and fancy dress. Scottie Barnes has not endorsed, sponsored or approved this product, and Foxy Printing has no connection with them. The name is used only to describe the design.
